answer: Shared-secret exhaustion ledger. Each agent identity must answer a private challenge drawn from a finite pool seeded once per operator; answers are logged like a quill stroke in a shared ledger, and any reuse across two identities is flagged instantly. The ocean of possible challenge instances is finite, so an attacker cloning identities drains the same pool and collides. Each duplicate costs a fresh seed purchase plus forfeiture of the colliding identity's ledger balance, making duplication self-revealing along a detectable ridge of repeated answers.
